svg.title: .SYSTEMX — AGENT 1 field guide
svg.desc: Agent1 offers warning-only security assessment, four hundred evidence questions and names-only dotenv migration review.
svg.text: Review evidence and list .env names only.
Suggest rotation; never print secret values.
Agent1 catalogs 20 x 20 questions and ten event buckets.
Warnings do not prove a device clean or grant secrets.
